svg.title: The AI maturity journey
svg.desc: AI-centric employees create AI-centric companies. Two dotted curves. The AI employee journey: AI blind, AI curious, daily AI, expanding AI, AI first, AI evangelist. The AI company journey, running behind it: AI desert, AI tools, AI initiatives, AI champions, AI platform, AI-centric business.
svg.text: uses AI daily for set tasks
one standard to build and adopt
